raster_grid.finding: Chromium paints this 14px footer text at whole-CSS-pixel vertical positions: padding 7.0-7.5, line-height 18-18.667 and text-rendering geometricPrecision all produce byte-identical glyph rows, while the layout line box moves by 1/64 px.

limits: The native reference is the capture retained for #48; it shows the same synthetic quarter content, but this is not a fresh device run and not actual-device sign-off (#44/#51).
Chromium snaps text rasters to whole CSS pixels at this size, so the remaining third-CSS-pixel (one physical px) offset cannot be removed by intrinsic typography without also moving the button paint.
One Chromium build on Windows with the bundled Roboto woff2; Android rasterization is not reproduced, only its measured ink rows.
Vertical darkening from the #49 dialog shadow is outside the footer crop and unchanged by this issue.
